data.name: Ahmaraan
data.gender_notes: Ahmaraan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahmaraan is a Quranic name derived from the Arabic word 'Ahm', which means 'Allah' or 'God'. The suffix '-araan' means 'lion'. Therefore, Ahmaraan signifies 'The Lion of Allah'. This name is a reminder of the strength and courage that comes from believing in and serving Allah. The name Ahmaraan carries the meaning “Lion of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahmaraan usually hope their child will grow to embody lion of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahmaraan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.context: Description of the Berber dynasty of the Banu Ma'qil in Algeria who adopted the name Ahmara or Ahmaraan, meaning 'brothers of Ahmar' after their founder Ahmar ibn Yahya.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Mas'udi's 'Muruj Al-Dhahab (The Meadows of Gold)', Book II The name Ahmaraan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of the Banu Hilal tribe, which was an Arab tribe that moved into the Nile Valley in Egypt during the Fatimid period and was known as 'Ahmaraan' or 'Ahmarites' because of their leader Ahmar ibn Sinan Al-Khawlan.
